items.title: Widerspruch gegen Ablehnung der Haushaltshilfe
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid können Sie innerhalb eines Monats, nachdem er Ihnen bekannt gegeben wurde, Widerspruch erheben.
items.computation: Letter dated Thursday 19.11.2026; no separate 'Tag der Aufgabe zur Post' stated, so posting day = letter date, 19.11.2026. Krankenkasse is a social-law body, governed by § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X: deemed delivered on the 4th day after posting, counting calendar days and not counting the posting day itself: day1=20.11 (Fri), day2=21.11 (Sat), day3=22.11 (Sun), day4=23.11 (Mon). Since this is a social-law body (not a tax office), the deemed-delivery day does NOT move even if it fell on a weekend/holiday; here it falls on a Monday anyway, so delivery = 23.11.2026. One-month Widerspruch period under § 84 SGG runs from delivery (day of delivery not counted, §§ 187, 188 BGB): one month after 23.11.2026, same day-number next month = 23.12.2026 (Wednesday). No NW public holiday on that date, so no shift under § 26 Abs. 3 SGB X / § 193 BGB is needed. Deadline: 23.12.2026.
